title: Behold a man who has never asked himself, “Am I the asshole?”
summary: When asked why, he gave The Playlist a… let’s say, revealing answer. “We sent it out to actors, and no Black actors wanted to play in a movie where there are no good Black people,” he said. “And it sort of died.
